{{Quote|This holoprojection was a gift from Queen Ressa of Drezzi to thank Darth Nyriss for her merciful treatment of the royal family when the Empire conquered their world. Her husband was executed, but the queen and her children were spared.|Sechel, to Scourge|<ref name="Revan" />}}
'''Ressa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who lived during the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. She was the [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drezzi]] for some [[Time/Legends|time]]<ref name="Revan" /> before [[3954 BBY]].<ref name="think">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the beginning of ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' to [[3954 BBY]]. As the novel also establishes that the [[Conquest of Drezzi|conquest]] of [[Drezzi]] occurred several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the novel's events, Ressa must have been [[Queen/Legends|queen]] at some point prior to 3954 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> During Ressa's reign, her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was [[Conquest of Drezzi|conquered]] by the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Ressa's husband]] was [[Death/Legends|executed]]. However, the lives of her and her [[Youngling/Legends|children]] were spared by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nyriss]]. To express her gratitude for Nyriss's mercy, Ressa gave her a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojection]] as a gift. Sometime later, the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Sechel]] told the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] the tale behind the holoprojection as Sechel took the latter to meet with Nyriss in her [[Darth Nyriss's stronghold|stronghold]] on the planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ressa was mentioned in ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', a [[2011]] novel written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]].<ref name="Revan" />
